payload.rebuttal: fixed: The test checked that the credential was gone and that Agent.redacted named the right shape, but never checked the marker text written in place of the credential. A wrong version that writes a generic "[redacted: a credential]" for every shape still passed, because found.append(description) in redact() was untouched by that edit. Added assertions, for every shape in the loop and for both no-END-line private-key cases, that the shape's own description string appears in the logged event's text and in the raw written file. Verified by applying the exact wrong version: the strengthened test now fails on it, and passes again once reverted.
